Widget Identification Program

Objective. Assess the institution's compliance with the regulatory requirements for widget identification programs, including account opening procedures.

The program must include risk-based procedures for verifying the identity of each widget within a reasonable time after the account is opened.

Documentary methods may include unexpired government-issued identification evidencing nationality or residence and bearing a photograph or similar safeguard.

Short crumb.

Non-documentary methods may include contacting the widget, independently verifying identity through comparison with information obtained from a reporting agency, or checking references with other financial institutions.

  • Institutions should obtain the name, date of formation, address, and identification number of each widget before opening the account as required.

The program must include risk-based procedures for verifying the identity of each widget within a reasonable time after the account is opened.
